meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任务计划和进度存成文件,清空对话后也能无缝接着干。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做需要多步骤完成的编程或研究任务,又担心对话记录被清空。
copy.tagline_en: Save plans and progress to files so your AI agent can resume after clearing the chat.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run long multi-step coding tasks and worry about losing context.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在项目目录创建并维护 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件，把任务计划、研究发现和进度写成文本存盘；做决定前重读计划，每完成一个阶段就更新状态、记录错误。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务，或需要约5次以上工具调用的工作时触发；会话启动时会自动从磁盘恢复已有计划，/clear 后也能继续。

say.text: 把这项开发任务拆成多步骤计划，写进 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会生成计划并逐步跟踪进度。

say.text: 研究这个主题，把关键发现记到 findings.md。
say.note: Claude 会边搜索边保存发现。

say.text: 我清空了对话，请按已有计划继续。
say.note: Claude 会读取磁盘上的计划文件接着干。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md in the project folder, saving the task breakdown, research findings, and progress as text on disk. It re-reads the plan before decisions and updates statuses and errors after each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or work needing 5+ tool calls. Existing plans are reloaded from disk each session, including after /clear.

say_en.text: Break this dev task into steps and write them to task_plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude creates a plan and tracks progress.

say_en.text: Research this topic and log key findings in findings.md.
say_en.note: Claude saves discoveries as it goes.

say_en.text: I cleared the chat; continue from the existing plan.
say_en.note: Claude reloads the plan files from disk.
